note: v1: WHERE'S THE ONE, deep minimal tech-house in G# minor, 121.5 rising to 122, built on THE BEAT FLIP (a phantom downbeat) - a time illusion, where my t5 and t6 are pitch ones. The groove puts its stabs and the riff's accents on the off-beats. At bar 41 the kick and hats leave and the ear re-anchors on those off-beats; at 45 the kick comes back an eighth LATE, on them, with the claps on the displaced backbeat, and the flipped groove sounds perfectly normal for twelve bars. Then two bars of nothing but the stab, and the kick returns on the TRUE beat, which now sounds like the off-beat until the claps on two and four pull the ear home; the return comes back changed, the riff an octave up. The break has no kick: the riff grouped in threes against the four (a hemiola) under a pad, and a voice saying 'one' where the hemiola puts its accent, never on the real one. The drop walks a new progression (G#m E B F#), flips again for four bars at 107, and at 121 its stabs move to the 'e' and the 'and', shifting the anchor once more; THE STAIR (G# A# B D#) is a celesta figure that starts on the off-beat. The outro thins to the riff's accents and settles the 808 on D# for t10. Seeds 0/11: 95.41 / 95.50 (the returns had to change: the same riff over the same progression made recurrence 0.81 on one seed; now 0.68 on both); -11.0 LUFS, TP -1.29, runs 2; spectrum 77.5 (37-60 Hz still heavy, the top short).

v2: THE VOICE COUNTS, and the seam. In the break, where the riff runs in threes against the four, the voice no longer just drops a lone 'one' in the wrong place: from bar 81 it COUNTS the hemiola aloud - one, two, three, one, two, three on its dotted-quarter pulse - talking the ear into the wrong meter, and as the drop lands it says 'one' on the TRUE downbeat, an octave of pitch lower and falling, and everything snaps home. The illusion said out loud. And the seam into t10: the kick stopped two bars before the end, so t9's tail was near-silent against t10's head (level jump 13.7 dB); now it runs to the last bar (0.7 dB). Kick a dB lower. Seeds 0/11 under the new album weights (v1 re-rendered: 86.60 / 86.42): 88.87 / 88.87, flow 33 -> 57; -11.0 LUFS, TP -1.29, runs 2.
